Given:

Circular track length = 840 m

Speed of A = 6 m/s

Speed of B = 12 m/s

Formula used:

Time to meet = Track length / Relative speed

Relative speed (since they are running in the same direction) = Speed of B - Speed of A

Calculation:

Relative speed = 12 m/s - 6 m/s = 6 m/s

Time to meet = 840 m / 6 m/s

=> Time to meet = 140 seconds

∴ A and B will meet next after 140 seconds

Let the distances covered by Pankaj and Rohit are 'd' m and (600 - d) m respectively.

Since, Pankaj and Rohit would have been covered the respective distances in same time.

So,

d/2.85 = (600 - d)/1.5

1.5d = 1710 - 2.85d

d = 1710/4.35

Now, the time, in which they will meet for the first time = 1710/(4.35 X 2.85)

= 138 seconds

= 2.3 minutes (approx.)
